Calculate the effective length of a hypothesis label

Source: R/f_hypothesis_label.R
alphaGraphHypothesisLabels.Rd

Underscores do not count. Characters following an underscore count at half length, rounded up, because they are rendered as subscripts.

Converts the part after a single underscore to Unicode subscripts supported by visNetwork. For example, H1_ni becomes H1 followed by subscript ni, and H1_(ni) also renders the parentheses as subscripts.

Usage

alphaGraphHypothesisLabelLength(label)

alphaGraphValidateHypothesisLabelLengths(
  labels,
  maxLength = .alphaGraphMaxHypothesisLabelLength()
)

alphaGraphRenderHypothesisLabel(label)

alphaGraphValidateHypothesisLabels(labels)

Arguments

label

Non-empty character scalar containing the editable label.

labels

Character vector of canonical hypothesis labels.

maxLength

Positive integer giving the maximum effective label length.

Value

Numeric scalar with the effective label length.

alphaGraphValidateHypothesisLabelLengths() returns the calculated effective lengths invisibly.

Character scalar suitable for display in visNetwork.

alphaGraphValidateHypothesisLabels() returns the rendered labels invisibly after validating syntax and uniqueness.
